When the tokens enter, Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three creature tokens, adding six {C}.

856-5632-5776-8095.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and Clue token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2738-4871-6798-6887.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, The Skullspore Nexus, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Sister Hospitaller
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Sister Hospitaller with haste.
When the Sister Hospitaller token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life
Repeat.

Repeat.

2741-3179-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Essence Warden trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Essence Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2741-3179-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

225-1479-5700-5701-7705.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-5700-5701-7705.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Mole Man trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Mole Man and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Mole Man triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

Activate Atog by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

586-1472-5147-5626.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi legendary creature token.

Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Keimi and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
Repeat.

147-2438-3890.description:
Cast Unearth by paying {B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}. 
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Unearth.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Unearth, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Unearth copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.

You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.

Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.

Elemental Mastery attached to Captain of the Mists.

"Human" chosen with Xenograft.

8-24.description:
Cast Selfless Squire by paying {3}{W}.
When Selfless Squire enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, preventing all damage that would be dealt to you this turn.
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}, selecting an arbitrarily large number, and dealing that much damage to you if you chose the largest number, which is prevented due to Selfless Squire.
Selfless Squire's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the damage prevented.
If you didn't choose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals damage equal to that number to each opponent who chose that number.

Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Goblin you control.
